data.title: Leash order for your dog "Bruno"
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt public order office (Ordnungsamt) ordered on 15 May 2025 that your dog must be kept on a leash of at most two metres outside your enclosed property, following an incident on 28 April 2025. A coercive fine of €250 is threatened for non-compliance.
data.explanation: The city has ordered that, with immediate effect, your dog must be on a leash no longer than two metres whenever it is outside your own enclosed property. If you break this rule, a coercive fine (Zwangsgeld) of €250 can be imposed. You may challenge the order by filing a lawsuit (Klage) at the administrative court (Verwaltungsgericht). There is no objection procedure (Widerspruch) first. The app shows the deadline for filing. The claim must be in writing or recorded at the court registry. Consider getting legal advice if you want to challenge it. Otherwise, follow the leash rule from now on.
